lines.zh: 我拖着长袍走，脚步很轻。
lines.en: I drag my long robes. Light steps.

lines.zh: 袍子底下什么也看不见。
lines.en: Nothing to see under these robes.
I walk slowly. No need to close in.

lines.zh: 我停在能看见你的位置。
lines.en: I stop where I can see you.
I don't pursue. I stand at the center.

lines.zh: 长袍扫过地面，留下一道痕。
lines.en: My robe sweeps a line across the floor.

lines.zh: 我一步步走到石头之间。
lines.en: Step by step, into the stones.
Dark light under my feet.
I circle the edge of the field.
My hat sits very low.

lines.zh: 我不需要走快，法术够远。
lines.en: No need for speed. My spells reach.
I turn. My hem makes a circle.
I stand. My hands move inside the robes.

lines.zh: 我念了一句谁也听不见的。
lines.en: I murmur something no one hears.

lines.zh: 暗紫色的光在我袖口闪。
lines.en: Dark purple light flickers at my cuff.

lines.zh: 我不用眼睛看，我用感觉。
lines.en: I don't look. I sense.

lines.zh: 我在这片地上画了个圈。
lines.en: I've drawn a circle on this ground.

lines.zh: 袍子底下没有脚，只有影子。
lines.en: No feet under this robe, only shadow.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬手指，灰聚起来。
lines.en: I lift a finger. Ash gathers.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，弹幕却不停。
lines.en: I stand still and my barrage never stops.

lines.zh: 我的袍子里有东西在转。
lines.en: Something turns inside my robes.
I'll stand until this round ends.
You're inside my circle.
This look is a calculation.
Weapon up. Standing too straight.

lines.zh: 我的脸在帽檐下，看不清。
lines.en: My face under the brim. Unclear.

lines.zh: 你每次换位置，我都知道。
lines.en: Every time you shift, I know.
Put out that torch and I'll leave.
I'm standing still. Don't run.
Your hand is looking for a shield. Too late.

lines.zh: 这一片的地面，都是我的。
lines.en: All this floor is mine.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的时候，法术已经在走。
lines.en: While I stare, the spell is already moving.
My brim got knocked crooked.
That broke half a phrase.
Half a step back. The circle remains.
You didn't hit a body.
I start the incantation again.
This doesn't impede the casting.
Hat straightened, so my spells fly true.

lines.zh: 我记下了你出手的时机。
lines.en: I noted your timing.
More impatient than I thought.
One step back and my barrage spreads out.
That in your hand. No energy.
I don't eat. I drain.
Holding it up won't help.
No interest in that.
Get back. Don't break the incantation.

lines.zh: 这点东西换不来一个法术。
lines.en: That won't buy a spell.
There's better on the floor.
That light in your hand. Distracting.
Drop it and I'll let you stand.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜土豆，我拿来喂乌鸦。
lines.en: Carrots and potatoes — I feed them to crows.
You walked into my robes.
Half a step back. The circle holds.
Don't come closer. I won't move.

lines.zh: 你碰到的是布，不是身体。
lines.en: You touched cloth. Not a body.

lines.zh: 我的手从袍子里伸出来了。
lines.en: My hand came out of the robes.

lines.zh: 这一下，你在圈里更深了。
lines.en: Now you're deeper in the circle.
I don't shove. I stand my ground.
That contact advanced the spell.
Back off. Out of the circle.

lines.zh: 我袍子上沾了你的味道。
lines.en: Your smell is on my robe.
This body is borrowed.
I don't need that.
Step outside the circle first.
My face isn't for looking at.
Under this hat, all is black fire.
Spells are more reliable than people.

lines.zh: 我这一生都在念同一段。
lines.en: My whole life is one incantation.
I stand still and my barrage never stops.
Three steps back. Keep going.
That, I won't answer.
I lift it without hands.

lines.zh: 这东西浮在我掌心上面。
lines.en: It hovers over my palm.
One look. I drop it back.
Worth keeping.

lines.zh: 这东西的光，被我吸干了。
lines.en: I drained the light right out of it.
Deep in my sleeve lies the last thing I took.
More here. Taking it all.
Yours. I smiled.
There are spell marks on this.

lines.zh: 我举起它看了看，没用了。
lines.en: I held it up. Spent.
You've entered the circle.
My hand is faster than yours.
The wall behind you makes a fine target.

lines.zh: 法术的第一句已经念完。
lines.en: The first line is spoken.
No point dodging.

lines.zh: 这里的地面很平，正合适。
lines.en: Flat ground. Suitable.
My sleeve is starting to glow.
You're warm. I can lock on.
I picked you. Nearest.
Hold still. I need to finish.
Only you on this floor.
I lift my hat a little.
Your steps slowed.
Second verse.
No rush. You have time to run.
But you won't get far.
I'm in position.
Watch here. Don't look away.
I stand still. The spell moves.
You go left. The spell follows.
My finger traces at my cuff.
Armor won't stop dark light.

lines.zh: 我在等你站到同一个点。
lines.en: Waiting for you to stand on the mark.
The circle brightens.
The spell moves; I stand still.

lines.zh: 弹幕排成一列，等着你露头。
lines.en: My bolts line up, waiting for you to show yourself.
Behind me won't help.
At this range, every shot lands.

lines.zh: 我袍子下面的手一直没停。
lines.en: My hands haven't stopped under the robe.
Stand there and you're a target.
The floor is moving. You can't tell.
This one's been charging a while.
Now retreat won't help.
Watch my sleeve.
The dark purple comes out.
Third line spoken.
Two. The casting fills.
One. No taking it back.
I point one finger at you.

lines.zh: 暗紫的光从袖口射出去。
lines.en: Dark purple light from my cuff.
You're pushed back. Clothes scorched.
That one flew low.

lines.zh: 我没有靠近，但我打到了。
lines.en: I didn't come close. Still hit.
Your guard was half an inch off.
The second follows the first.
A black scorch on the floor.
You rolled half a turn on the ground.
One step back. One more phrase.
That one cost me.
Still moving. I'm surprised.

lines.zh: 我不擅长近身，但也不是没有手。
lines.en: Close quarters isn't my strength. I still have hands.

lines.zh: 这一发是从你背后来的。
lines.en: That one came from behind you.

lines.zh: 我的袍子挡住了你的视线。
lines.en: My robes blocked your line of sight.
The dark light pinned you in place.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的手指有点抖。
lines.en: That one left my fingers trembling.

lines.zh: 你退了，我的圈还在这里。
lines.en: You retreat. My circle is still here.
Dark light burst at your feet.

lines.zh: 你举起盾，光从下面绕过。
lines.en: You raised a shield. The light went under.

lines.zh: 我在空地上画下第一个圈。
lines.en: I draw the first circle on open ground.
The robe settles. Dust scatters.
I fade in out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 石头之间的空气变冷了。
lines.en: The air between the stones cools.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，帽檐下面是黑的。
lines.en: I raise my head. Black under the brim.

lines.zh: 我脚下有暗光，从中心散开。
lines.en: Dark light spreads from under my feet.

lines.zh: 这里的主世界，看起来不错。
lines.en: The Overworld. Looks acceptable.
I begin the first verse.

lines.zh: 我的袍子是新的，人不是。
lines.en: The robe is new. I'm not.
You happened to be born inside the circle.

lines.zh: 我不需要移动就能攻击。
lines.en: I can attack without moving.
In place. The position is calculated.
Fire on my hem. I pat it out.

lines.zh: 摔下去的时候咒语断了。
lines.en: Falling broke the incantation.

lines.zh: 水浸了袍子，重得动不了。
lines.en: Water in the robes. Too heavy to move.
The blast wiped my circle away.
Something passed through my robes.
That magic counters mine.

lines.zh: 没有能量可吸，咒语变弱。
lines.en: No energy to draw. The spells weaken.

lines.zh: 雷打在圈上，符文全散了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the circle. Runes scattered.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候我还在念。
lines.en: Falling. Still reciting.
